pr.title: feat(cli): add new --worktree, with git-stk owning the worktrees it creates
pr.body: `new --worktree` creates the branch in a worktree of its own instead of checking it out here, so your current checkout stays where it is. Location comes from `stk.worktreeDir`, defaulting to a `-worktrees` sibling, with branch names nested as real directories so `feat/a`'s basename still matches the branch tail. git-stk records the worktrees it creates (`branch..stkWorktree`) and **owns removing them**: cleanup takes an owned one away when its branch lands - before deleting the branch, since git refuses otherwise - but never touches one you made by hand, and keeps an owned one that still has uncommitted work in it. `repair` reconciles the marker both directions: it clears a stale one, and re-adopts an unmarked worktree sitting exactly where `new --worktree` would have put it (without which a lost marker would strand the directory forever). Closes #283 - 🟣 ~~[fix(sync): skip a trunk fetch and a landing checkout another worktree blocks (#295)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/295)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[docs(guide): add a worktrees tour covering the flows and gotchas (#294)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/294)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add new --worktree, with git-stk owning the worktrees it creates (#293)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/293)~~ (merged) 👈 - 🟣 ~~[feat(run): run in a scratch worktree by default, with --no-worktree to opt out (#292)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/292)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(cli): add --from-path to nav commands so cd can follow a branch (#291)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/291)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(list): show which worktree holds each branch in list and status (#290)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/290)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(code): explain worktree collisions instead of leaking git's fatal (#289)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/289)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(code): keep a worktree-held branch instead of failing cleanup (#288)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/288)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(restack): preflight worktree-held branches and clear stale state (#287)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/287)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[fix(stack): refuse an undo that would rewind branches held by worktrees (#286)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/286)~~ (merged) - 🟣 ~~[feat(code): add git::worktree_branches to detect branches held elsewhere (#285)](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk/pull/285)~~ (merged) - `main` --- Stack managed by [git-stk](https://github.com/lararosekelley/git-stk)

expected.description: The default worktree directory is derived from the current worktree's root instead of the main worktree, so `new --worktree` run inside a worktree nests the next one under it and repair looks for owned worktrees in the wrong place.
